governance_note: Define what moves, with units and time scale.
Document supply, demand, source, sink, and boundary choices.
Define edge capacities and review uncertainty or time variation.
State whether nodes conserve, store, lose, transform, queue, or delay flow.
Document whether costs mean distance, time, money, risk, emissions, or loss.
Review cuts, saturated edges, bottlenecks, and vulnerability surfaces.
Test capacity, cost, demand, boundary, and edge-failure perturbations.
Review who benefits from or bears access, delay, cost, and vulnerability tradeoffs.
